prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Her left leg wears a pale pink satin ribbon wound in an even spiral around her left leg from the ankle up to just below the knee, crossing over the front of the shin and tied in a neat bow at the outer side of the knee, resting snug on the skin and running down into her heel. Her right leg wears a black fishnet thigh-high stocking with a wide lace-trimmed top band, the diamond mesh hugging her right thigh, knee, calf and ankle and running down into her heel, her deep ebony-brown skin showing through every opening of the net, matching the rest of her body. Her left arm wears a glossy deep-red latex arm sleeve from her left wrist up to the upper arm, her hand and fingers bare, stretched with mirror shine and fine pull-creases at the elbow. Her right arm wears a glossy deep-red latex arm sleeve from her right wrist up to the upper arm, her hand and fingers bare, stretched with mirror shine and fine pull-creases at the elbow. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme powerlifter silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy black latex, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in glossy black lacquer with a high polish.
Piercing: a large curved gold navel barbell with a big heart-shaped pink gem, resting directly on her skin at her navel.
Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, heavy gold rings on every finger, and large drop earrings of mixed metals, a gold chain ending in a heavy silver weight on each ear, hanging above her collarbones. Jewelry is metal and pearl only.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips.

Background: a bright planetarium lobby with a polished pale floor, a curved white wall, a standard-height door and a low step, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
